dedupe_keys.name: narita international airport indoor map open data mlit

description: This dataset is the indoor map of Narita International Airport made for demonstration experiments of the high-precision positioning society project run by Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. It contains the base map of corridors and rooms, pedestrian space network data, and points of interest for public facilities such as toilets and elevators. The current version is the fiscal 2020 update published on 10 March 2021, which replaces an earlier release. Coverage is one site, the airport terminals. The data are free under the Japanese government standard terms of use and are downloaded from the G-Space Information Center as shapefiles, GeoPDF and PDF, with a product specification and legends; downloads require user registration and login. Caveats: it reflects the terminals as of 2020, and downloaders may be asked to answer a survey. The pedestrian network supports evacuation and emergency response modelling in terminals, agent-based passenger flow studies and indoor digital twins. It complements the Japanese pedestrian network data (Hokonavi) and the MLIT civil aviation statistics catalogued here.
